children: Radian Guaranty Inc., the mortgage insurance subsidiary of Radian Group Inc. (NYSE: RDN) today announced its mortgage insurance quotes are now available through Lender Price, a cloud-native, AI-driven mortgage pricing engine used by leading banks, lenders, credit unions, and mortgage brokers.

The integration provides Lender Price users with seamless access to quotes powered by RADAR® Rates, Radian’s proprietary risk-based pricing model, without leaving their existing workflow. RADAR® Rates is designed to dynamically analyze individual loan and borrower characteristics to deliver pricing tailored to a loan's unique risk profile and attributes. For those clients who prefer to utilize the traditional rate card approach, these can also be accessed via the same integration.

“Today's lenders expect pricing tools that are fast, intuitive, and integrated into the platforms they use every day,” said Steve Keleher, Co-Head of Mortgage Insurance at Radian Guaranty. “By bringing Radian's mortgage insurance quoting capabilities to Lender Price, we're making it easier for customers to access competitive rates. This integration helps lenders evaluate scenarios more efficiently, improve workflow productivity, and deliver a better experience for borrowers.”

“At Lender Price, our focus is helping lenders simplify complex pricing decisions through modern, highly scalable and flexible technology,” said Paul Orlando, Chief Strategy Officer at Lender Price. “Integrating Radian's mortgage insurance quoting capabilities powered by RADAR® Rates into our platform gives lenders seamless access to a trusted MI provider as part of a unified origination experience.”

Radian Group Inc. (NYSE: RDN) is a trusted, global multi-line specialty insurer that helps businesses navigate risk with confidence.
